title: Concept: File access built from input (c) — review required
description: In c, fopen(strcat(d, f), "r") assembles a filesystem path from parts. Traversal payloads (..%2f, absolute paths, symlink races) redirect the operation outside its directory. The c-specific remedy is confinement via realpath plus prefix check.
applicability: c codebases opening files with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write when untrusted input reaches the path; HIGH severity because traversal payloads are trivial and impact is filesystem-wide.
